reply.subject: Re: URGENT - revised prices from 1 Dec (8-12%)
reply.body:
Dear Vikram,

Thank you for your note on the revised prices. We are not able to accept an increase of 8.0% to 12.0% on this range, because at our current prices it would take the margin below what we can carry and passing it on would push us well above the market.

Our counter, line by line: TW-01 at ₹219.24 (4.4%), TW-02 at ₹187.92 (4.4%), TW-04 at ₹378.00 (5.0%) and TW-06 at ₹147.00 (5.0%). These are the most we can take while staying competitive.

On your offer to absorb half of the revision if we commit to 1,500 units a month: on our sales forecast the chance of reaching 1,500 units in 30 days is 2.8%, so we cannot count on it. We would reconsider if the commitment were lowered to 720 units in 30 days, or if the 1,500 units were measured over 90 days.

Regards,
Category team
